rules.text: A written rule is not enforcement. When docs/RECURRING_ISSUES.md gains a hard invariant, add the matching assertion to WidgetContractInvariantsTest in the same commit.
The authoritative source for widget XML invariants is WidgetContractInvariantsTest, not the XML comment. Assert both resizeMode and widgetFeatures when you touch either.
Adding a user-facing string means adding it to all six locale files: values/, values-zh/, values-zh-rCN/, values-zh-rHK/, values-zh-rTW/, values-b+zh+Hant/.
Route widget commands through CountUpContract or WidgetNavigationContract. Never call a sibling receiver's pending-intent helper directly, and never merge the four receivers into one.
A release commit is not bookkeeping. Run ./gradlew assembleRelease and install the release APK before tagging, not after.
Do not resurrect a 1x1 Hero layout. It was removed twice, the second time as an explicit product decision.
One widget family per commit. The manifest, provider XML, receiver, configure activity and layout are five testable units, not one.
Change CountUpViewModel.kt and CountUpViewModelTest.kt together; the project expects a fix to ship with its test change.
Never add android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO or any microphone permission; speech is delegated out-of-process and needs <queries> entries instead.

checklist.text: Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest; 402 unit and contract tests must pass before you start.
Read docs/RECURRING_ISSUES.md; it is the authoritative widget defect list.
Confirm a clean tree with git status --porcelain.
Touching resizeMode or widgetFeatures: assert both invariants, not only the one you are fixing.
Adding a user-facing string: add it to all six locale files.
Touching one widget receiver: check its siblings and route commands through CountUpContract or WidgetNavigationContract.
Adding an invariant to docs/RECURRING_ISSUES.md: add the assertion to WidgetContractInvariantsTest in the same commit.
One widget family per commit; do not land a whole suite.
Run both ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest and ./gradlew assembleRelease; debug-only verification has missed R8 breakage here.
Never commit anything under keystore/, and do not make this repository public until history is scrubbed and the release key rotated.
Do not add android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO or any microphone permission.
